title: GitHub - vandith1/agent-guard: A pre-execution guard that stops your coding agent running destructive commands. One shell file, no dependencies.
excerpt: A pre-execution guard that stops your coding agent running destructive commands. One shell file, no dependencies. - vandith1/agent-guard
content_html:
Your coding agent will eventually run git reset --hard, force-push to main, or drop a table. Not because it's careless — because it's confident, and the loop drifted three steps ago.

Try it in your browser → — paste any command, see whether it would be blocked and by which rule. Nothing is sent anywhere; the rules run locally.

This is a ~60-line shell hook that stops the commands you can't undo. It runs before every shell command the agent proposes, exits 2 to deny, and writes the reason to stderr — which agent CLIs feed back into the loop, so the agent stops retrying and surfaces the command to you instead.

BLOCKED by guard [discard all local changes (git reset --hard)]
  command: git reset --hard HEAD~3
  This one is gated to the human. Do not retry, do not reword.
  Surface the exact command and let the human run it.

Install

bash install.sh          # merges a PreToolUse hook into .claude/settings.json
bash test-guard.sh       # 6 assertions, should be 6 passed / 0 failed

Works with Claude Code's PreToolUse hook, and with any agent CLI that runs a shell hook before a tool call and respects its exit code. Requires bash, grep -E, and python3.

What it blocks

git reset --hard · rm -rf · git clean -f/-x · git checkout . · git filter-branch · force-push to main/master/production · DROP TABLE · TRUNCATE · FLUSHALL · aws delete-*/terminate-* · kubectl delete · terraform destroy · docker … prune · chmod 777 · curl … | sh · raw writes to /dev/sd*.

Rules live in one array at the top of the script as label@@regex pairs. Edit them. Add a test case when you do — including a benign command the new pattern must not catch. That's how you find an over-greedy regex before it finds you.

What this does and does not stop

It stops: a confident agent proposing an irreversible command in plain text, which is the failure mode I actually hit — the loop drifted three steps ago and the next command discards a day's work.

It does not stop: anything deliberately evading it. g""it reset --hard, a base64 payload through eval, a shell script, an alias. The matcher is a regex over the proposed command string, and a regex loses to an adversary every time.

That distinction is the whole threat model, and it is worth being blunt about: if your agent is obfuscating commands to get around a hook you installed, a pattern list is not your problem. This assumes a well-intentioned model having a bad moment, not a hostile one.

It also does not replace the things that are strictly more reliable because they sit outside your machine: server-side branch protection, least-privilege credentials, and backups. Nothing here is a substitute for any of those. Use them, and use this for the irreversible operations they do not cover — a hard reset on uncommitted work, a recursive delete, a dropped table, a destroyed stack.

A seatbelt, not a rollcage.

Two things worth knowing

It matches the whole command string, arguments included. So a commit message that quotes a gated phrase gets blocked. That's deliberate: the alternative is parsing shell quoting, expansion and eval, and every parser is a new way to slip a command past the guard. Fail-safe beats clever. The habit that fixes it: git commit -F .commit-msg instead of -m "…", never a heredoc.

It fails closed. If it can't read the command out of the hook payload, it blocks. A guard that silently degrades to "allow everything" is worse than no guard, because you'd stop watching.

The idea behind it: two tiers

Destructive commands and external-effect commands are different problems.

  • Tier 1 — rm -rf, reset --hard, DROP TABLE. Unrecoverable. Never negotiable, no unlock, not even for you-in-a-hurry. This repo is tier 1.
  • Tier 2 — git push, npm publish, deploys, migrations. Real effects, but reviewable and reversible. These shouldn't be banned — they should be gated, unlockable by a human for a short window that auto-relocks.

Tier 2 is where the design gets interesting: the unlock has to be something the agent can't touch, including refreshing its timestamp to extend the window or deleting it to hide that it was used.

The full kit adds tier 2 with the time-boxed unlock, a config file, a git pre-push hook, an isolation workflow, a merge gate that catches prompt regressions with a deterministic grader, and the incident write-ups behind each rule: https://andevan.gumroad.com/l/agent-control-kit

MIT licensed. Take it, fork it, ship it in your own tooling.

content_html_zh:
您的编码代理最终将运行 git reset --hard、强制推送到 main 或删除表。 不是因为它粗心——因为它自信，而且循环在三步前就漂移了。

在浏览器中尝试一下 → — 粘贴任何命令，看看它是否会被阻止以及被哪条规则阻止。 没有任何东西被发送到任何地方；规则在本地运行。

这是一个大约 60 行的 shell 钩子，可以停止您无法撤消的命令。 它在代理建议的每个 shell 命令之前运行，退出 2 以拒绝，并将原因写入 stderr - 代理 CLI 反馈到循环中，因此代理停止重试并向您显示命令。

BLOCKED by guard [discard all local changes (git reset --hard)]

  This one is gated to the human. Do not retry, do not reword.
  Surface the exact command and let the human run it.

安装

bash install.sh          # merges a PreToolUse hook into .claude/settings.json
bash test-guard.sh       # 6 assertions, should be 6 passed / 0 failed

可与 Claude Code 的 PreToolUse 挂钩配合使用，并可与在工具调用之前运行 shell 挂钩并遵守其退出代码的任何代理 CLI 配合使用。 需要 bash、grep -E 和 python3。

它阻止了什么

git reset --hard · rm -rf · git clean -f/-x · git checkout 。 · git filter-branch · 强制推送到主/主/生产 · 删除表 · 截断 · FLUSHALL · aws delete-*/terminate-* · kubectl 删除 · terraform destroy · docker … 修剪 · chmod 777 · 卷曲 … | sh · 原始写入/dev/sd*。

规则以 label@@regex 对的形式存在于脚本顶部的一个数组中。 编辑它们。 当你这样做时添加一个测试用例 - 包括新模式不能捕获的良性命令。 这就是你如何在过度贪婪的正则表达式找到你之前找到它。

这会做什么和不会停止

它停止了：一个自信的代理以纯文本形式提出一个不可逆的命令，这就是我实际上遇到的失败模式——循环在三步前漂移，下一个命令放弃了一天的工作。

它不会停止：任何故意逃避它的事情。 g""it Reset --hard，通过 eval 的 Base64 负载，一个 shell 脚本，一个别名。 匹配器是针对建议的命令字符串的正则表达式，正则表达式每次都会输给对手。

这种区别就是整个威胁模型，值得直言不讳：如果您的代理混淆命令来绕过您安装的挂钩，那么模式列表不是您的问题。 这假设一个善意的模型有一个糟糕的时刻，而不是一个敌对的时刻。

它也不会取代严格更可靠的东西，因为它们位于计算机之外：服务器端分支保护、最低权限凭据和备份。 这里没有任何东西可以替代其中任何一个。 使用它们，并将其用于它们未涵盖的不可逆操作 - 对未提交的工作进行硬重置、递归删除、删除表、破坏堆栈。

安全带，不是防滚架。

两件事值得知道

它匹配整个命令字符串，包括参数。 因此，引用门控短语的提交消息会被阻止。 这是经过深思熟虑的：替代方案是解析 shell 引用、扩展和 eval，并且每个解析器都是一种让命令绕过守卫的新方法。 自动防故障胜过聪明。 解决这个问题的习惯是： git commit -F .commit-msg 而不是 -m "…"，绝不是定界符。

关闭失败。 如果它无法从钩子有效负载中读取命令，则会阻塞。 一个默默地降级为“允许一切”的守卫比没有守卫更糟糕，因为你会停止观看。

其背后的想法：两层

破坏性命令和外部效果命令是不同的问题。

  • 第 1 层 — rm -rf、reset --hard、删除表。 无法恢复。 永远没有商量余地，没有解锁，即使对于匆忙的你来说也是如此。 该仓库是 1 级仓库。
  • 第 2 层 — git 推送、npm 发布、部署、迁移。 真实的效果，但可审查且可逆。 这些不应该被禁止——它们应该有门控，可以由人类解锁并在短时间内自动重新锁定。

第 2 层是设计变得有趣的地方：解锁必须是代理无法触及的东西，包括刷新其时间戳以扩展窗口或删除它以隐藏它已被使用。

完整的套件添加了第 2 层，包括时间盒解锁、配置文件、git 预推送挂钩、隔离工作流程、使用确定性分级器捕获提示回归的合并门，以及每条规则背后的事件记录：https://andevan.gumroad.com/l/agent-control-kit
